stock_options.rule: Paper only. Each stock pick (call for a BUY pick, put for a SELL pick) is bought when the share crosses its entry between 09:30 and 10:30, while still within 1% of it: 1 lot in each budget, the strike nearest the money (priced Rs 2 or more) costing up to Rs 5,000, Rs 5,000-10,000 and Rs 10,000-15,000. Stop -30%, cost after +20%, trail from +40%, book +60%, else close 15:15. Costs Rs 100 + 1.5% each way.
stock_options.research: 2-year test on NSE's real prices, same-day trades: every budget LOST on average (up to Rs 5k: -Rs 232 a trade, 30% won; Rs 5-10k: -Rs 312, 35% won; Rs 10-15k: -Rs 412, 36% won). Booking early at +Rs 1-2k was worse, and past winning stocks, results days and news gaps did not hold up either. Paper only, to see how each budget does.
